title: Countable generation descends along a faithfully flat ring map
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that if R to S is faithfully flat and the base change M tensor S is countably generated, then M itself is countably generated (statement lines 22601-22606). The proof does not use the isomorphism criterion for descent in general: it writes each of countably many generators of the base change as a finite sum of pure tensors, takes the submodule generated by the resulting countable family of coefficients, observes that the induced map on base changes is surjective because the image contains the generators, and applies faithful flatness to upgrade surjectivity to equality (proof lines 22608-22617). Using faithful flatness to detect equality of submodules is the step that carries the argument, and countability is preserved because each generator uses only finitely many coefficients. H2.
